topic: The signed Hermite coefficient mode and its difference sequence
title: Resolving the Hermite coefficient conjectures in OEIS A381423, Comments (revision 8)

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We prove Mike Sheppard's conjecture in OEIS A381423, Comments, revision 8, that the exponent of the largest signed coefficient of the physicists' Hermite polynomial has successive differences in {1,-3}. A coefficient-ratio calculation gives an explicit formula and proves uniqueness, square-root growth, and the two asserted difference-block lengths. We give exact quadratic indices for the longer blocks. The corresponding absolute-coefficient calculation proves the conjecture in A381524 and the three formulas for equal absolute maxima in A381737. It also gives the absolute mode explicitly, locates its two difference-block types, and determines the asymptotic ratios of successive maximal coefficients.
summary: For every n>=0 the signed coefficient maximum is unique, at a(n)=n-4 floor((2n+7-sqrt(8n+21))/8). Its differences are 1 or -3, and a(n)=sqrt(2n)+O(1). The absolute mode b(n) has differences 1 or -1, explicit length-two/three blocks, and |a(n)-b(n)|<=2. For the maximal signed and absolute values B(n), M(n), B(n)/M(n) tends to 1 and both successive-value ratios divided by sqrt(n) tend to sqrt(2).

verification.lean_scope: Least-signed-maximizer characterization and difference values for all natural degrees, for the literal physicists' finite expansion.
